title: Reject exact c=1 MoE-tail cross-stream prequeue

premise.change: Record routed completion on the primary stream, make the low-priority shared stream wait for it behind shared-down, enqueue the unchanged fused aggregate+residual+next-RMSNorm tail on that stream, then make the primary stream wait for tail completion.

correctness.fused_tail_gpu_oracle: byte exact to the registered three-kernel fallback at hidden 17 and 3072

directional_gate.shape: p512/d128 eager c=1, one same-resident alternating pair

interpretation: Two additional record/wait dependencies per sparse layer cost more than the Python-visible predecessor gap they were intended to hide.
llama.cpp Vulkan amortizes graph recording in command buffers; fine-grained HIP event choreography is not an equivalent mechanism.
